python_interfaces.name: InventoryTrackingAllocator
python_interfaces.rule: allocators are monotonic/non-reusing with explicit exhausted sentinel; allocation occurs under writer lock and identifiers are business/display handles, never PKs

python_interfaces.name: DevicePartUnitRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Device Part Unit references LLD-03 Device Reference and SR context but remains Inventory-owned operational component identity

python_interfaces.name: SpareNeedRepository
python_interfaces.rule: active Need aggregation is exactly SR+BOM key; contributor count is derived from active contributor relationships and never substitutes for planned quantity

python_interfaces.name: SpareRequestRepository
python_interfaces.rule: request derives one SR from allocations; draft allocations are mutable only through revisioned relationships, while accepted submission snapshot freezes submitted membership/quantities separately

python_interfaces.name: RmaRepository
python_interfaces.rule: RMA is obligation identity; C10 is current business identifier plus immutable aliases; direct inbound/return selection are distinct relationships

python_interfaces.name: SparePartUnitRepository
python_interfaces.rule: physical identity survives later SR7/C10/serial provenance; one RMA may have one direct inbound unit but extracted units may share origin provenance through parent

python_interfaces.name: TaskUnitAllocationRepository
python_interfaces.rule: at most one active allocation per Spare Part Unit; allocation is planning/reservation only and never installation proof

python_interfaces.name: PhysicalConsequenceRepository
python_interfaces.rule: consequence references exact upstream Task review fingerprint but owns only Inventory physical interpretation/relationships; correction never edits Task outcome

python_interfaces.name: ActualLogisticsRepository
python_interfaces.rule: event may cover many RMAs/Spare Part Units while every participant has immutable own identity and exact correction history

python_interfaces.name: FaultTagRepository
python_interfaces.rule: submitted membership history is immutable; material submitted correction creates replacement lineage rather than rewriting membership

python_interfaces.name: FaultTagWarehouseRepository
python_interfaces.rule: warehouse receipt and final decision are separate; accepted closes RMA return obligation, rejected leaves it open and enables a later resend

python_interfaces.name: InventoryProposalTargetService
python_interfaces.owner: LLD-07 consumed by future LLD-09 communication proposal adapter
python_interfaces.rule: communication evidence is proposal only; apply revalidates owning Inventory lifecycle and runs in caller UoW when cross-domain orchestration requires it; provider/message bodies never enter Inventory tables

python_interfaces.name: InventoryTaskDependencyProvider
python_interfaces.rule: accepted allocation/physical consequence/protected Inventory history blocks Task hard delete; retry cloning copies only explicitly selected currently eligible planning relationships and never physical consequence history

python_interfaces.name: TaskOperationalEvidenceReader
python_interfaces.rule: LLD-07 consumes exact reviewed Task outcome/evidence but has no Task writer

python_interfaces.name: InventoryReferenceReader
python_interfaces.rule: submission/pickup snapshots capture only represented historical values; changes to master data never rewrite snapshots

python_interfaces.name: DevicePartInstalledComponentResolution
python_interfaces.rule: optional explicit relation preserves both immutable identities and never transfers Inventory lifecycle authority to Infrastructure

python_interfaces.name: InventoryReportSectionContributor
python_interfaces.rule: emits minimized Inventory summary/constituent facts only; no full lifecycle event bodies, communication evidence bodies or mutable duplicate status truth

typed_physical_unit_ref.rule: exactly one variant is present; database tables use two nullable FKs plus CHECK rather than unchecked polymorphic text target

evidence_reference.rule: optional internal adapter reference only; Beta 1.0 Inventory UI has no manual file upload/attachment input and no file path/blob is accepted through this contract

transaction_rule: Repositories never commit. Standalone Inventory commands create one receipt/UoW. LLD-05 retry participants and future LLD-09 accepted proposal participants reuse the caller's exact UnitOfWork/command context and never insert a second receipt or commit independently.
